statement: Whenever busy_student(startTime, endTime, queryTime) returns a result r, r is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < n and startTime[i] <= queryTime and queryTime <= endTime[i]; equivalently, r is the number of students whose closed interval [startTime[i], endTime[i]] contains queryTime.
preconditions: Let n = len(startTime). Assume len(endTime) = n, 1 <= n <= 100, 1 <= queryTime <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= startTime[i] <= endTime[i] <= 1000.

statement: busy_student(startTime, endTime, queryTime) returns a result r; it does not fail (no out-of-bounds access or arithmetic overflow) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: Let n = len(startTime). Assume len(endTime) = n, 1 <= n <= 100, 1 <= queryTime <= 1000, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= startTime[i] <= endTime[i] <= 1000.
